comment: each header sticks to the top of the scrollport while its section is in view and leaves with its section (the containing block); captured in flow, stuck, being pushed out by the end of its section, and with the next header stuck. Rendered without MSAA ("samples": 1), at the default tolerances: with 4x MSAA, Mesa's llvmpipe and lavapipe (the test image's GL and Vulkan drivers, Mesa 23.2.1) let half the samples of the row above and the column left of a scissor rectangle through, so content scrolled past a clip edge would show a half-covered 1 px line there (MsaaScissor.FourSamples reproduces it with raw sokol calls; the scissor reaches glScissor/vkCmdSetScissor as exact integers, the max edges are exact)
